name: QCEW annual-average data slices
use: Annual average pay by county, state or nation and industry / ownership
note: Only disclosed annual-average records are accepted. Cache availability is reported separately. Ownership is selected explicitly; public school, public university and local public administration defaults may not match every employer.

name: Census Geocoding Services API
use: Matched address, state and county FIPS
note: Address-range match only; does not prove building existence or estimate indoor RF coverage. Application supports 50 states and DC.

name: 2018 CBECS, Table B1: Summary of floorspace, workers and operating hours
use: Published square feet per main-shift worker
note: Office 507; inpatient 628; education 1,314; lodging 2,431; warehouse/storage 2,222. Education and lodging are broad proxies. Administrative government buildings use office proxy. Industrial manufacturing is not covered. No shift multiplier.

name: In-Building Mobile Connectivity Report
year: 2019 per project brief; publication date not independently confirmed on report page
use: 44 direct lost hours per fully affected workforce equivalent per year
note: Survey of 500 managers; industry-sponsored report describes up to 44 hours. Used as an assumption, not a causal workplace measurement or guaranteed outcome. Report revenue estimates are not used.

organization: Clayton, Leshner and Almond; Journal of Computer-Mediated Communication
name: The Extended iSelf: The Impact of iPhone Separation on Cognition, Emotion, and Physiology
use: Context for separation anxiety, physiological stress and cognitive distraction
note: Small laboratory experiment involving an unanswered ringing phone. Does not establish a 1% annual workplace effect or measure indoor dead-zone losses.

organization: Hartanto and Yang; Singapore Management University / Computers in Human Behavior
name: Is the smartphone a smart choice? The effect of smartphone separation on executive functions
use: Context for anxiety, working memory, inhibition and task switching
note: Experimental separation findings support a possible mechanism, not an annual loss rate. No direct translation from experiment to 1% is claimed.

name: Baseline model version 2.0
use: 44 direct hours; 1% cognitive allowance; 2,080 hours; proportional exposure; unchanged five-year projection
note: The defaults are editable in data/methodology.json. Cognitive hours are derived, not stored separately. Additive components may overlap. Input quality labels are not confidence intervals.

name: Facility and building inputs
use: Address, building type, gross area, coverage, FTE/headcount and Wi-Fi context
note: User controls coverage. FTE overrides headcount and proxies. Inputs are not independently measured or audited by this application.
